version.author: BLV
version.changelog:
Now for Windows too (checked on Windows 11 with REAPER 7.82 and ReaImGui 0.10.0.5), as well as macOS.
- Pressing Esc to close a song's right-click menu no longer closes the whole ReaLobby window. - The clean-up list shows each file relative to the song's folder on Windows too ("Audio/take.wav"), not its full path. - The unused-audio check lists each folder once, so it finishes sooner (most noticeable on Windows, where each folder listing takes about a quarter of a second).

version.author: BLV
version.changelog: - Double-clicking a song now asks "Open …?" first (Enter or Open confirms). Switch it off in Settings → Behaviour. Enter in the list still opens at once. - Much faster: each scan folder is read in one go, and projects already read are remembered between starts. In a test with 150 songs, the first scan dropped from about 12 seconds to about 2, and later starts take about a fifth of a second. - Going back to a song shows its bounces, backups and checks at once (folder listings are reused for a few seconds). - A close button (×) at the top right closes ReaLobby and leaves you in the empty project. Esc still does the same. - Settings redesigned: tabs across the top (Overview, Folders, Statuses, Look, Behaviour). Overview shows four cards with the main facts and switches; each Edit link opens its tab. On/off choices are switches, and the window has its own close button.
